deployments_detail.use: AI Centre of Excellence + FutureSmart Mining; 2025 annual report cites AI for "operational excellence"; formal governance and use cases in mining ops

Fully autonomous drone-in-a-box system (DJI Dock 2 / Matrice 3D) with AI-driven mission orchestration for automated infrastructure inspection and volumetric/3D mapping at the Quellaveco copper mine in Peru; first Peruvian mining project to adopt automated drone operations. [FlytBase; UAV Latam; Pix4D]

Advanced analytics automation with Alteryx: automated fuel-usage tracking at Quellaveco, $1bn+ rough diamond inventory ETL at De Beers, and audit/business-assurance analytics; 13 analysts trained on the low-code platform. [Alteryx]
deployments_detail.value: 97% improvement in fuel tracking time (2 days to 30 min); diamond month-end balancing cut from ~1 week to 2 days; thousands of manual hours saved

deployments_detail.use: Bulk ore sorting (BOS): sensor + AI mineral classification system that identifies copper grade in real time and rejects sterile material before processing, deployed at the El Soldado copper mine in Chile. Scaled from an initial 900 t/h to 8,000 t/h throughput. [Anglo American (in-house, FutureSmart Mining)]
deployments_detail.value: Throughput scaled from 900 t/h to 8,000 t/h; enables flotation at 350 microns vs 150 previously

deployments_detail.use: Coarse particle recovery (CPR) plus bulk ore sorting AI-optimised processing at Quellaveco, using AI to reduce energy and water intensity while recovering more metal from ore. [Anglo American (FutureSmart Mining); Microsoft (cloud)]
deployments_detail.value: 30% improvement in energy efficiency and 50% reduction in fresh water abstraction

deployments_detail.use: Scientific-AI stockpile and inventory optimisation application for strategic ore reclaim and reducing feed variability, using a 3D block model of stockpiles at the Minas-Rio iron ore operation in Brazil. Won the 2024 Mining-Metallurgical Industry Excellence Award. [IntelliSense.io]

Autonomous haulage: fleet of 32 Cat 794 autonomous mining trucks running Caterpillar MineStar Command for hauling at the Quellaveco copper mine in Peru, with high utilisation and physical availability. [Caterpillar (MineStar Command); Ferreyros (support)]

Autonomous Haulage System (FrontRunner AHS) planned for deployment across 62 Komatsu 930E ultra-class haul trucks at the Los Bronces copper mine in Chile, integrated with Modular Mining DISPATCH fleet management. [Komatsu (FrontRunner AHS); Modular Mining (DISPATCH)]

Teleremote bulldozers: Komatsu D375Ai-8 dozers with automatic blade control and Modular Mining ProVision machine guidance, operated remotely at the Minas-Rio iron ore mine in Brazil; reached commercial operation with plans to expand to six D475A-8R dozers. [Komatsu; Modular Mining (ProVision)]

VOXEL (Vision of Operational Excellence) proprietary digital platform with an integrated data lake and AI for resource modelling, asset maintenance, mine planning, safety/health pattern detection and processing optimisation; underpins the Integrated Remote Operations Centre (IROC) at Los Bronces. [Anglo American (proprietary IP); Microsoft (cloud infrastructure)]

AI-powered process digital twins of the Quellaveco processing plant (grinding, flotation, tailings, water and electrical systems) built on Siemens COMOS with Simatic PCS-7, used for simulation, optimisation and failure reduction, controlled from the Integrated Operations Center; Peru's first 100% digital mine. [Siemens (COMOS, Simatic PCS-7)]
Digital twin plus AI applied at an Australian metallurgical coal operation to identify a production bottleneck and boost mine productivity (more tonnes). [Anglo American]
